findings.title: Overlapping store activations could allow an older requested owner to become active
findings.fix: Capture incremented generation before first await; stale activation returns owner-changed.

findings.title: Observed repeated PATCH after committed connection loss can return zero rows and falsely conflict
findings.fix: Read back exact attempted token and payload after zero-row response.
findings.mechanismQualification: Browser evidence establishes a repeated mutation after the committed response connection was closed. It does not establish whether Chromium/transport or another client layer repeated it. The vendored SDK explicit retry policy applies only to GET/HEAD/OPTIONS; do not attribute mutation retry to that SDK policy.

findings.title: Movies Use account continuation could clear another owner dirty flags
findings.fix: Recheck owner generation after preserve and flush before clearing metadata.

findings.title: Movies delayed read could replace a newer locally acknowledged save
findings.fix: Serialize account reads/reconciliation and writes through movieOperationChain.

findings.title: Dogs explicit account replacement could discard edits made after its preserved snapshot
findings.fix: replacementLocked prevents new mutations through preserve/read/adoption; guarded internal reconciliation saves.

findings.title: Restore/recovery success could be announced after persistence failure
findings.fix: Movies Restore reports localSaved; Dogs recovery checks saveAll outcome.

findings.title: Throwing localStorage getter could crash shared-store construction
findings.fix: Lazy storage access evaluated inside protected read/write operations.

findings.title: Unchanged reconciliation writes made otherwise current tabs stale
findings.fix: Raw, metadata and acknowledgement no-op detection avoids revision bumps.

findings.title: Movies local validation accepts unsupported syntactically valid payloads
findings.schedule: Owner raw ranking {movies:"broken"} or [null] passes JSON.parse; normalization treats it as empty or invalid items before later replacement.
findings.requestedFix: Validate supported raw shapes and item arrays before mutable load.
findings.fix: validMovieStoredPayload validates supported per-key shapes and movie arrays; invalid raw remains preserved with editing blocked.

findings.title: Auth subscription starts after initial session read and owner activation
findings.schedule: Initial A session resolves; cross-tab signout occurs while local activation awaits; no app listener yet; stale A may render before subsequently emitted INITIAL_SESSION corrects.
findings.requestedFix: Subscribe before initialization and guard late getSession results by auth transition generation, or disprove schedule.
findings.fix: Both apps subscribe before getSession. Movies uses bootstrap event precedence; Dogs uses observed-event fencing plus owner activation generations.

findings.title: Remaining Movies conflict notification continuations need owner guard
findings.schedule: Account changes while preserve awaits; subsequent conflict copy/status should not alter new owner UI.
findings.fix: Movies conflict continuations recheck owner token after preservation before updating current UI.

findings.title: Dogs background reconcile can update comparison ranking while a session is active
findings.requestedFix: Defer background reconciliation until active rank/review completes, or invalidate/reset before applying changed ranking.
findings.fix: Dogs invalidates comparison/review/undo/import transient work before adopting changed remote placement.

findings.title: Delayed sign-out completion could clear a newer signed-in owner UI
findings.fix: Both apps reject stale successful sign-out continuations; current auth callback owns the resulting transition.

findings.title: Resolved recoveries consumed bounded capacity without an accessible reclaim path
findings.fix: Both apps include resolved entries; explicit dismiss is available. Source receipts prevent dismissed original snapshots from being re-offered.
findings.evidence: tests/data-safety.test.js resolved recovery capacity reclaim test

findings.title: Memory-only departure recovery needed an explicit non-durable warning
findings.fix: Both apps label session-only entries and show prior-owner departure warnings without exposing foreign recovery contents.

findings.title: A queued Movies save could read newer mutable state after awaiting only an earlier local flush
findings.schedule: queueMovieSync captures a localSave promise immediately, then waits for the remote operation chain. A newer edit can change raw/metadata while its own local flush is still queued or Web-Lock-blocked. Reading current raw/spec after awaiting the old localSave does not prove that newer state has passed local revision validation.
findings.requestedFix: Retain immediate local flush and also await a fresh flush inside each remote surface iteration before capturing current baseline/spec; recheck owner/conflict after that await.
findings.fix: Immediate localSave remains outside the network queue. Each remote surface now awaits a fresh flushMovieDevice result, rechecks owner/conflict, and synchronously captures baseline/spec before dispatch.
findings.evidence: app.js queueMovieSync re-reviewed; node --check app.js passes. Targeted held-write/local-lock browser verification is owned by the browser reviewer.

findings.title: Dogs initial account loading could finish against a superseded owner and leave the latest owner pending
findings.fix: Register every owner activation; complete initialization only after a stable latest activation and generation survive catalog/local/account reconciliation. Refuse owner-null or mismatched account reads.
findings.evidence: reports/data-safety/2026-10-07T06-13-02-844Z/results.json: delayed A read and A to B to A sharing both pass

findings.title: Dogs recovery controls inherited floating settings layout and overlapped phone content
findings.fix: Dedicated in-flow recovery class with contained select/buttons; Movies select also constrained and its labels made readable.

findings.title: Expected stale-tab safety conflict escaped as an uncaught initial-load promise rejection
findings.fix: Catch only the already-reported DataSafetyError conflict at the Movies operation boundary; unexpected errors still propagate. The permanent runner now fails on uncaught exceptions.
findings.evidence: Final staged45/45 with strict exception gate; local-verification.json
